implementation.train_run_profile_actor_retention: run_profile now records actor_retention in summary/result.
implementation.checkpoint_retention_guard: retained checkpoint actor files are written only when promotion eligible and walk_forward_evaluated are both true.
implementation.candidate_actor_policy: main trained actor remains a candidate artifact for walk-forward evaluation, not a final retained/promotable actor.

risk_notes: This does not create a new passing model.
It prevents future retraining loops from treating checkpoint-retention artifacts as final retained models before walk-forward promotion passes.
